Name: Penalty (Max die)
Description: Inflict a penalty on a hero based on the Max die.

Name: Persistent Penalty (Min die)
Description: Inflict a persistent and exclusive penalty on a hero based on the Min die.

Name: Lose a Green Ability
Description: A hero temporarily loses access to one of their Green abilities.

Name: Power/Quality Reduced
Description: One of the hero's powers or qualities is temporarily reduced in die size.

Name: Persistent Penalty (Max+Min)
Description: Inflict a penalty on a hero based on the Max+Min dice, persistent and exclusive.

Name: Location-Wide Penalty
Description: Inflict a penalty on all heroes in the same location based on the hero's Max die.

Name: Lose Multiple Abilities
Description: A hero temporarily loses access to a number of their abilities.

Name: Lose a Power/Quality
Description: The hero temporarily loses access to one or more of their powers or qualities.

Name: Enemy Bonus (Max die)
Description: Grant a bonus to a villain or group of minions/lieutenants based on the Max die.

Name: Persistent Enemy Bonus (Min die)
Description: Grant a persistent and exclusive bonus to a villain or group of minions/lieutenants based on the Min die.

Name: Upgrade Villain Die
Description: Upgrade a villain's power or quality die temporarily.

Name: Persistent Enemy Bonus (Max+Min)
Description: Grant a bonus to a villain or group of minions/lieutenants based on the Max+Min dice, persistent and exclusive.

Name: All Enemies Bonus
Description: Grant a bonus to all villains/minions/lieutenants based on the hero's Max die.

Name: Upgrade All Villain Dice
Description: Upgrade all of a villain's power or quality dice temporarily.

Name: Damage to Hero (Mid die)
Description: Deal damage to a hero based on the Mid die.

Name: Location-Wide Damage (Min die)
Description: Deal damage to all heroes in the same location based on the Min die.

Name: Damage to Hero (Max+Min)
Description: Deal damage to a hero based on the Max+Min dice.

Name: Location-Wide Damage (Mid die)
Description: Deal damage to all heroes in the same location based on the Mid die.

Name: Scene-Wide Damage
Description: Deal damage to all characters (heroes, minions, bystanders, etc.) in the scene based on the Mid die.

Name: Defend an Enemy (Max die)
Description: Defend a nearby villain or single minion/lieutenant with the Max die.

Name: Defend an Enemy (Mid+Max)
Description: Defend a nearby villain or single minion/lieutenant with the Mid+Max dice.

Name: Defend All Enemies
Description: Defend all nearby enemies with the Max die.

Name: Add Threats (Minor)
Description: Add a quantity of hostile or neutral threats equal to the Min die of the roll that caused the twist.

Name: Add Threats (Major)
Description: Add a quantity of hostile or neutral threats equal to the Mid die of the roll that caused the twist.

Name: Piggyback a New Challenge
Description: Introduce a new challenge building on what the hero just accomplished. Never invalidates the original success -- twists add cost, they don't remove wins.

Name: Advance the Scene Tracker
Description: Move the Scene Tracker forward as an effect of the twist.

Name: Combine Twist Types
Description: Mix two or more twist types for a bigger moment, e.g. Hinder with the Max die while also adding minions equal to the Min die. Especially good for mixing story twists with mechanical ones.

Name: Difficult Choice
Description: The heroes must make a difficult choice.

Name: Bargain Something Away
Description: The heroes must bargain something away.

Name: Fall Into a Trap
Description: The heroes fall into a trap.

Name: Separated
Description: The heroes are separated from each other.

Name: Sacrifice Something Important
Description: The heroes must sacrifice something important.

Name: Identity at Risk
Description: The heroes are in danger of revealing their identity.

Name: Wrong About an Ally
Description: The heroes discover they were wrong about an ally.

Name: Villain Discovers a Secret
Description: Meanwhile: a villain discovers your treasured secret.

Name: Resource in Danger
Description: Meanwhile: one of your resources is in danger.

Name: Ally Contemplates Betrayal
Description: Meanwhile: a trusted ally contemplates betrayal.

Name: Kid Finds Your Base
Description: Meanwhile: a kid stumbles across the entrance to your base.

Name: Missed Life Event
Description: Meanwhile: you miss an important life event.

Name: Reporter Learns a Weakness
Description: Meanwhile: a reporter learns your embarrassing weakness.

Name: Watched from Unseen Cameras
Description: Meanwhile: someone watches from unseen cameras.

Name: Old Foes Ally
Description: Meanwhile: old foes of yours make an alliance.

Name: Enemy Plot Progresses
Description: Meanwhile: an enemy progresses their plot.

Name: Vehicle Sabotaged
Description: Meanwhile: someone sabotages your vehicle.
